_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Wi-Fi password and the read-only token go in secrets.py, not here.
_nodes: Up to 4 collectors, shown top to bottom as the status blocks on the right edge. 'name' must match the node name the collector reports (TANKWATCH_NODE, or its host name). 'label' is what the shows print: keep it to 3 characters. 'address' is only used if the hub stops answering, to check the collector directly. Mark the computer running the hub with "hub": true. 'icon': 'fish' draws a fish on the uptime screen, numbered with the label's last digit; 'heart' draws a heart that beats while the collector is up (a good fit for the hub).
_readings: Which location's air and water readings the sign shows (the 'location' in each collector's config.yaml). Leave one out and its screen shows --.
_ranges: Colours: blue below the range, green inside it, orange above it (degrees F).
